ds4c.pack.effects.name: DS4C Effects
ds4c.pack.effects.desc: DualSense adaptive trigger rules for Controlify
ds4c.config.title: DS4C
ds4c.config.trigger_effects.tooltip: Use DS4C's adaptive trigger rules. When off, Controlify's own trigger effects still apply.
ds4c.config.trigger_strength.tooltip: Scales the resistance and vibration of DS4C's trigger effects. Lower it if the triggers tire your fingers.
ds4c.config.hd_haptics.tooltip: Play DS4C's haptics through the DualSense grips. Needs a USB connection and Controlify's HD haptics setting turned on. Turn Controlify's "Allow Vibrations" off: its rumble mutes HD haptics, and DS4C covers those events itself.
ds4c.config.footsteps.tooltip: A light tap for each footstep and small landing, shaped by the ground underfoot.
ds4c.config.synthesis_intensity.tooltip: Scales DS4C's generated effects (footsteps, heartbeat, ambient loops) without changing haptics taken from game sounds.
ds4c.config.falloff_near.tooltip: Sounds closer than this many blocks play at full strength.
ds4c.config.falloff_far.tooltip: Sounds fade out by this many blocks. Some sounds have a shorter range of their own.
ds4c.config.group.categories.tooltip: Turn whole groups of trigger effects and haptics on or off.
ds4c.config.category.movement.tooltip: Footsteps, landings, rides, slowing blocks, swimming, fireworks and the elytra.
ds4c.config.category.combat.tooltip: Swings, hits, bows, crossbows, tridents, shields, maces, damage, explosions, the totem and the Warden.
ds4c.config.category.ambient.tooltip: Rain, water, wind, magma, portals, lightning, boss events and nearby bees, conduits and beacons.
ds4c.config.category.items.tooltip: Eating, drinking, fishing, goat horns, the spyglass, compass, clock and item breaks.
ds4c.config.category.environment.tooltip: Mining, placing blocks, buckets, hoes, shears, spawn eggs, doors, chests and levers.
ds4c.config.category.ui.tooltip: Haptics for pickups, level-ups, toasts and workstation results.
ds4c.setup.no_haptics.bluetooth: [DS4C] Your DualSense is on Bluetooth, so its HD haptics can't play. Connect it with a USB cable to feel DS4C's grip haptics.
ds4c.setup.no_haptics.linux: [DS4C] HD haptics aren't available for your DualSense. Check Controlify's HD Haptics option is on and, on Linux, that the controller's audio uses the Pro Audio (or Direct) profile. See DS4C's linux-hd-haptics guide.
ds4c.setup.no_haptics.generic: [DS4C] HD haptics aren't available for your DualSense. Check it's connected by USB and Controlify's HD Haptics option is on.
